record.question: Russia is going to train how many Indian astronauts for India's ambitious manned mission to space, Gaganyaan?
record.explanation: Answer C: Four. Contemporary ISRO/PIB reporting said four astronaut candidates had been selected for Gaganyaan training in Russia. Reference: https://www.pib.gov.in/Pressreleaseshare.aspx?PRID=1598205; https://www.isro.gov.in/media_isro/pdf/docs/UsefulLinks/ParliamentQuestions/budget_session_2020.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
